base.about: the template every phone gets: flat outside, 1.0 mm back skin under lengthwise channels on the phone side, vented at both ends and into the camera window; 1.0 mm corner bumpers; universal window where the plateau is full width

case.about: full case: a window per button, fitted camera ring, full back

slot.about: one button slot per side, fitted camera, full back

magsafe.about: pockets for the ADG 42.1 magnet array, glued in from the phone side; action and side buttons as flexure keys where the phone has them

sides.about: top and bottom walls open between the corners

corners.about: held at the four corners only, walls open between them

skeleton.about: back cut to a 3 mm band, the camera ring and the MagSafe magnet ring on struts, the phone's back open to air between them; 1.5 mm corner bumpers; carries magpack

frame.about: back kept as an 8 mm band round the edge, universal top-band camera window

backless.about: side walls with a 1.5 mm band of back, universal top-band camera rim

plateframe.about: frame with a rebate for the swap-in back plate

plate.about: 1 mm swap-in back plate for plateframe, dropped in from the phone side and held by the phone

spine.about: 1.5 mm band and a full-width strip across the fitted camera ring carrying slider rails

slider.about: lens cover for spine, printed flat on its outside face, slides down clear of the lens and flash keepouts

cig.about: snap clip for one unlit cigarette along the right edge of the back; PETG softens near 80 C

corner.about: bottom-right corner only, 45 mm of each edge: squircle corner, USB-C edge and speaker group, a fit test that prints in minutes

ribs.about: full case, ribbed back: 1.2 mm between 1.2 mm ribs on a 10 mm grid, 2.0 at the ribs

ribcorner.about: the corner coupon with a ribbed back: 1.2 mm between 1.2 mm ribs on a 10 mm grid, 2.0 at the ribs

flip.about: full case carrying a front cover on a 3DS-style hinge along the left edge: two end knuckles, stop shelves for the cover open flat at 180, 1.5 mm corner bumpers

cover.about: 2 mm front cover for flip, its barrel runs between the case's knuckles on a 1.75 filament pin
